commits.author: Junhao186
commits.message:
Merge pull request #22 from jjlim7/feat/tournamentservicev2

Feat/tournamentservicev2

Tournament Micro Service API End Points

Tournament Filter operation while searching
GET /tournaments/{id}: Getting tournament by ID
GET /tournaments/name/{name} Getting tournament by name
GET /tournaments/date-range: Getting tournament by date range

Tournament Basic Operations
PUT /tournaments/{id}: Updating tournament
DELETE /tournaments/{id}?requestingAdminID={adminID}: Deleting of tournament by admin who created it
POST /tournaments/{tournament_id}/leave/{player_id}: Leaving tournament
POST /tournaments/{tournament_id}/join/{player_id}: Joining tournament
POST /tournaments/create: Creating tournament
GET /tournaments: Get all tournaments

Others
POST /tournaments/load-from-csv: loading of seed data

There are other API operations and its all IPC between different micro services, which is documented in my swagger
